 bob Green PLUG Launched 
 bob Green PLUG Launched
 Bank of Baroda supports India’s expanding EV charging ecosystem
 Lal Singh, Executive Director, Bank of Baroda 
 FinTech BizNews Service        
 Mumbai, November 19, 2026: Bank of Baroda, India’s leading public sector banks, announced the launch of bob Green PLUG, a specialized financing scheme designed to support the establishment and expansion of Electric Vehicle (EV) charging stations, battery-swapping infrastructure and allied facilities across the country. With finance ranging from above Rs10 lakh up to Rs5 crore, bob Green PLUG aims to support India's growing EV charging ecosystem, promote clean mobility and reinforce the Bank's commitment to sustainable finance.
 As EV adoption gathers pace across India, the need for a robust, accessible and reliable charging network is becoming increasingly critical. Government initiatives such as PM E-DRIVE, coupled with rising consumer adoption of electric vehicles, are expected to drive investments in EV charging and battery-swapping infrastructure, creating significant opportunities across the EV ecosystem while supporting India's transition to cleaner mobility.
 Against this backdrop, bob Green PLUG seeks to address the financing requirements of businesses participating in India's EV ecosystem. The scheme provides funding for both establishment of new facilities as well as expansion of existing EV charging and battery-swapping infrastructure.  Available to a wide range of MSME borrowers viz. startups, EV charging-point operators, fuel stations, fleet operators, commercial establishments, logistics hubs, residential societies and other entities, the scheme supports public charging stations, private/captive charging stations, commercial EV charging facilities and battery-swapping infrastructure.
 Speaking on the launch, Shri Lal Singh, Executive Director, Bank of Baroda said, "India's transition to electric mobility requires charging infrastructure that is accessible, reliable, commercially sustainable and available at scale. As EV adoption grows, businesses investing in EV charging infrastructure will play a critical role in building this network across cities, highways and key commercial locations. Recognising the evolving financial requirements of this sector, bob Green PLUG will provide tailored financing solutions for viable charging and battery-swapping projects. The scheme reinforces Bank of Baroda’s commitment to sustainable finance and supporting India's clean mobility journey."
 Key features of bob Green PLUG 
 Financing for public EV charging stations, private/captive charging stations, commercial EV charging, battery-swapping facilities, and allied infrastructure.
 Term Loans or Demand Loans from above Rs10 lakh up to Rs5 crore for eligible projects.
 Competitive interest rates ranging from 8.15% to 9.60% per annum, linked to the Bank's BRLLR, loan amount and the borrower credit rating.
 Repayment tenure of up to 120 months, including a moratorium period of up to 12 months.
 The scheme also supports renewable energy-integrated charging infrastructure, including rooftop solar-powered charging stations.
 Funding for ancillary facilities such as cafeterias, utilities, etc limited to the lower of Rs1 crore or 25% of the total sanctioned loan amount.
 Eligible facilities may be covered under the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE), subject to applicable guidelines.
